New to the Market – Exceptional 3 Bedroom Detached Bungalow on c.0.75 Acres
Lugakeeran, Castlerea, Co. Roscommon, F45 TA48

Guide Price: €260,000

Nestled in a truly peaceful and private rural setting, this outstanding 3-bedroom detached bungalow sits on a beautifully maintained c.0.75 acre site, surrounded by mature hedging, shrubbery and landscaped gardens, offering complete tranquillity with nature right on your doorstep.

This is a home that delivers privacy, space and lifestyle, yet remains highly convenient located just 10 minutes from Castlerea Town, 3 minutes from Ballinagare Village, with easy access to the N5 (Dublin–Westport route) and local bus links nearby.

The property is presented in excellent condition throughout, combining comfort, energy efficiency and superb outdoor space ideal for families, remote working, or those seeking a quiet countryside retreat.

Accommodation Comprises:

Kitchen / Dining Area:
Beautiful split-level open plan kitchen/dining space, fully fitted with tiled splashback and flooring, gas hob, timber flooring in dining area, coving and recessed lighting.

Patio doors open to a stunning south-facing garden, filling the space with natural light.

Living Room:
Bright and spacious with double aspect windows, timber flooring, coving, and a solid fuel stove with back boiler and stainless steel flue.
Bedrooms:

Bedroom 1: Carpeted, timber ceiling, curtains and light fittings

Bedroom 2: Carpeted, fitted storage, curtains and coving

Bedroom 3 / Sitting Room: Flexible use, carpeted, coving with attic access

Guest WC:
WC, WHB, shelving and extractor fan

Main Bathroom:
Fully tiled with white suite, pump shower over bath, Victorian-style heated towel rail radiator, vanity unit and mirror

Features Include:
c.0.75 acre mature, private site with south-facing rear garden

14 PV solar panels with inverter (feeding house & grid)

Grant oil-fired central heating system

Solid fuel stove with back boiler

New dual-system insulated immersion tank (oil / solid fuel / solar)

PVC windows and doors

Fully insulated attic (12-inch Earthwool)

Celtic water softener & purification system

Ample car parking

Private cul-de-sac setting with panoramic countryside views

Outside & Additional Buildings:

Landscaped gardens with greenhouse and mature planting

Two fuel sheds
Garage and carport

Large workshop – fully insulated, damp proofed, concrete floor, ESB connected, double glazed, with heating system and roller doors
Changeover switch for emergency generator supply

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a home that offers true peace, privacy and self-sufficient living, with all modern comforts already in place.

A property like this doesn’t come to the market often — a hidden gem in the heart of the countryside.
Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment.
Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers
086 2130723 | 094 9362216
